intent: Reconcile authorization, system evidence, trust boundaries, and threat hypotheses into a defensible risk and mitigation decision.
successCondition: Verified findings are separated from hypotheses, risks are ranked by exploitability and impact, mitigations have proof and rollback, and no action exceeds established authority.

direct: audit an authorized agent or mcp tool chain
review an acquired agent skill before indexing or promotion
review authority for a consequential external action
paraphrased: bind an acquired capability to exact inert evidence before trusting it
map how identities and permissions could be abused
rank exploitable security findings and prove the mitigations
work out whether this proposed action stays inside granted authority
contextual: an acquired skill has not yet passed static and semantic trust gates
an external write is proposed and its authority needs a defensible decision
the system crosses several trust boundaries and needs an evidence-ranked review
tool permissions changed and residual security risk must be reconciled
